questions.prompt: PTX vs SASS: which statement is right?
options: SASS is portable across GPU generations
PTX is a virtual ISA with unlimited registers; SASS is the real, architecture-specific machine code
questions.explanation: ptxas turns PTX into SASS for one architecture.

questions.prompt: Straight-line code where at most 9 values are ever live at once. How many registers does an optimal allocator need (no spills)?
questions.explanation: Maximum live is the lower bound, and linear scan achieves it on straight-line code.

questions.prompt: A thread uses 40 registers on an SM with a 16,384-register file. How many warps fit?
Which dependence must keep the consumer at least the producer's latency after it?
A loop body is ld.shared %x; fma %s, %x, %x, %s; (index, compare, branch), with one warp per SM. Best single transform?
options: Unroll with several independent accumulators, so loads and FMAs overlap and overhead is amortised
questions.explanation: One warp can't hide the 24-cycle latency without independent work.

questions.prompt: Why is ld.shared.v4 an instruction-selection win in a register-tiled GEMM?
options: One instruction loads four values, cutting load instructions per FMA by 4×

questions.prompt: What does software pipelining a GEMM inner loop cost?
options: Registers: the next step's operands are live alongside the current step's
questions.explanation: Overlap needs storage for both stages.

questions.prompt: In Triton, who decides how a tile's work maps onto threads and shared memory?
questions.explanation: The programmer chooses tiles; the compiler implements them.

questions.prompt: On a register-starved SM, a kernel stalls on global loads at the maximum warps that fit. Which fixes can both help?
options: Fewer registers (more warps) and hoisting independent loads (more ILP): measure which wins, since ILP costs registers
questions.explanation: Occupancy and ILP trade against each other through the register file.

questions.prompt: Why does an autotuner measure rather than predict?
options: The best tile configuration depends on interacting effects (occupancy, tails, reuse, registers) that simple models get wrong
questions.explanation: Models guide the search; measurement decides.
